reasoning_content: Now bacon and sqlx-cli. bacon is for live reload (run-dev). sqlx-cli for migrations. Let me install them. These may take a while. Let me install both. Actually let me first try `just setup`, but it needs wasm-pack and bacon for run-dev. Let's install bacon and sqlx-cli.

action.command: . /root/.cargo/env; cargo install bacon >/tmp/bacon-install.log 2>&1; echo "bacon exit=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/bacon-install.log; bacon --version 2>&1 | head -1; cargo install sqlx-cli --no-default-features --features rustls,postgres >/tmp/sqlx-install.log 2>&1; echo "sqlx exit=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/sqlx-install.log; sqlx --version
